_comment: transfer.py 结构锁定换皮规格示例：图1=source 锁结构（alpha 逐字节回写，必填），图2=reference 只管外观（可选，去掉此字段则纯文字描述外观，像素管线不变）。appearance/preserve_objects/forbid_from_reference 拼进三层英文约束 prompt（forbid 仅在有 reference 时有意义）；preserve_rects 是后端像素保护（色键=只回贴矩形内匹配颜色的原图像素）。命令：python transfer.py run --spec 本文件 [--install]
appearance: cool medium-gray and white coat with soft furry texture
white fluffy eyebrow patches above both eyes
white muzzle and lower face, fluffy
white chest patch with the approximate contour impression of Image 2, adapted onto Image 1's exact body shape
white paws and white tail tip; keep the rest of the coat medium gray
match the gray-white pattern distribution and edge contours from Image 2; soft plush fur feel but keep the original toy-like cute rendering
preserve_objects: small floating paw icon on the right
